detail.longDescription: Hi HN, I'm Stephan. I'm an ex-CTO and many companies I look in today, want to get AI coded apps into production, but engineering code reviews are the new bottleneck - and engineers don't even love to do them. No more code reviews. Fuzz instead. appfuzz works with WASM and runs the .wasm thousands of times against a simulated backend and reports problems: crashes, n+1 queries, XSS, SQL injection, leaked secrets, blown IO/CPU/instruction budgets. Try it of your own - you don't need an app for the demo: https://appfuzz.dev Why: agents write code faster than anyone can review it, and in many companies people outside engineering (marketing, sales, support) want to ship apps too - pressure from the CEO is high. But then engineers get the pager alerts. One way to make them safer is to treat them like iPhone/iOS apps: sandbox, permissions, app review (what appfuzz does). It works with Wasm components in any language, Spin, wasmCloud, Fastly Compute, and Shopify Functions. MIT. Very early state. Which platform should I add, and what should it look for? https://appfuzz.dev
